name: The Queen
source:
In the school town isolated from the outside world, she sits at the very top of the social hierarchy, wielding absolute power over anybody and everybody else. The students and teachers call her "Queen", and they're in awe of her. As well as the students' social classes, the Queen also holds the right to decide anything that goes on in the school. Even teachers aren't able to disobey her. Wearing an extravagent dress and wrapping herself in her veil, her real name or face, as well as everything else about her, is shrouded in mystery.

[Taken from [URL=http://otome-jikan.net/2014/04/28/zettai-kaikyuu-gakuen-eden-with-roses-and-phantasm/]Otome Jikan[/URL].]
